title: Glitchpad
descriptor: A fast, cross-platform viewer and editor for local files.
role: Open, view, inspect, and selectively edit common local file formats.
audience: Developers, support engineers, reverse engineers, and technical power users.
governing_principle: Make common local files easy to open, read, inspect, and edit. Keep controls compact and predictable.

avoid: language that makes the interface the subject

assumptions: Glitchpad inspects files locally and never executes their contents.
The product name is written as Glitchpad in prose and lowercase only in technical identifiers.
Pure sulfur is the identity accent; muddy and darkened yellow variants are prohibited, while inherited orange remains reserved for emphasis and warning states.

chart_palette.rationale: Retain the canon hue rotations and chroma relationship while using a darker, saturated target on the product surface. Chart colors are functional data colors, never decorative brand accents.

prohibitions: Do not detach the G from the paper into a separate glyph.
Always keep the rectangular paper-and-G construction inside its permanent square enclosure.
Use the approved contextual inversion: sulfur square on dark surfaces and charcoal square with sulfur paper on light surfaces.
Never use muddy or darkened yellow variants in the Glitchpad identity.
Do not add fragments, scan lines, glow, bevel, texture, or motion effects.
Do not alter the 720 by 900 paper, 70-unit G channel, 70-unit inset, or safe square composition.
logo.geometry_provenance_reason: The shipped Glitchpad paper-and-G paths predate glyphkit and have no authoritative mk_paths.py source.

guide.descriptor: Text, source code, images, PDFs, and office documents.
guide.foundation: Glitchpad opens common local file formats on desktop and Android. View text, source code, Markdown, raster and vector images, PDFs, DOCX, and ODT files. Edit Markdown, text, and source files where supported.
personality: Uses plain labels and short sentences
Keeps controls compact and file content visually primary
Novel interaction for its own sake
promises: Common file formats open in one app across desktop and Android.
Content, structure, and metadata use familiar navigation.
Markdown, text, and source files can be edited where supported.
in_scope: Text, source code, Markdown, images, PDFs, DOCX, and ODT
Search, navigation, document metadata, image dimensions, and EXIF
Editing Markdown, text, and source files where supported
out_of_scope: Replacing a dedicated editor or forensic suite
guide.sharp_edge: File contents can be sensitive or malformed. Glitchpad reports what it can read and does not determine whether a file is safe.
guide.logo: The rectangular paper and G share one protected construction inside a permanent square. On dark surfaces the square is sulfur with a charcoal page; on light surfaces the square is charcoal with a sulfur page. The slate fold stays consistent across both contexts.
guide.palette: Near-black surfaces keep controls visually secondary to file content. Pure sulfur provides identity, focus, and selection; cool slate supplies the fold and subdued states. Muddy and darkened yellows are prohibited.
